name: intake
title_zh: 草稿一句话，还你一份能直接开工的 AWS 项目简报
tagline_zh: 别在聊天框里反复解释背景。丢个模糊想法进来，它替你追问、补齐、写成 ~/aws/<name>/BRIEF.md。
tagline_en: Stop re-explaining context. Drop a vague idea, it interrogates, fills gaps, and writes a brief that /scaffold-aws.
desc_en: Turn a rough idea for a new AWS site into an approved, written project brief (~/aws/<name>/BRIEF.md) that /scaffold-aws can provision from with no conversation context.
why_zh: 它把「想清楚」从你的脑子里搬到文件里——用结构化追问逼出边界、依赖和验收标准，而不是替你拍板。
why_en: It moves 'thinking it through' from your head into a file—structured probing forces out scope, deps, and acceptance criteria.
limit_zh: 只认 AWS 新站点立项，不碰已有架构改造或非 AWS 项目；产物止于 BRIEF.md，不含任何代码或资源清单。
limit_en: Only for new AWS site briefs, not refactors or non-AWS. Output stops at BRIEF.md—no code or resource lists. Requires /scaffold-aws in agent-homelab.
title_en: Rough idea in, build-ready AWS project brief out
